sn55.54:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.54:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti:
sn55.54:1.5: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti:
sn55.54:1.7: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.54:1.9: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
sn55.54:1.11: na kho netaṃ bhante, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
sn55.54:1.12: “sappaññena upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ovaditabbo”ti.
sn55.54:2.1: sappaññena mahānāma, upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno catūhi assāsanīyehi dhammehi assāsetabbo.
sn55.54:2.3: atthāyasmato buddhe aveccappasādo “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.54:2.5: atthāyasmato dhamme aveccappasādo “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”ti. assasatāyasmā atthāyasmato
sn55.54:2.6: saṅghe aveccappasādo “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti. assasatāyasmā atthāyasmato
sn55.54:3.1: sappaññena mahānāma, upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. imehi catūhi assāsanīyehi dhammehi assāsetvā evamassa vacanīyo.
sn55.54:3.4: “atthi me mātāpitūsu apekhāti. so evamassa vacanīyo.
sn55.54:3.7: no cepāyasmā mātāpitūsu apekhaṃ karissati marissateva.
sn55.54:4.2: “yā me mātāpitūsu apekhā sā pahīnā”ti, so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:4.5: “atthi me puttadāresu apekhā”ti. so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:4.7: sace pāyasmā puttadāresu apekhaṃ karissati marissateva,
sn55.54:4.8: no cepāyasmā puttadāresu apekhaṃ karissati marissateva.
sn55.54:5.2: “yā me puttadāresu apekhā sā pahīnā”ti, so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:5.5: “atthi me mānusakesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu apekhā”ti, so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:5.6: “mānusakehi kho āvuso, kāmehi dibbā kāmā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
sn55.54:5.7: sādhāyasmā mānusakehi kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā cātummahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti.
sn55.54:6.2: “mānusakehi me kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, cātummahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti”. so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:6.3: “cātummahārājikehi kho āvuso devehi tāvatiṃsā devā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
sn55.54:6.4: sādhāyasmā cātummahārājikehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti.
sn55.54:7.2: “cātummahārājikehi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti”. so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:7.3: “tāvatiṃsehi kho āvuso, devehi yāmā devā abhikkantarā ca paṇītatarā ca. sādhāyasmā tāvatiṃsehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā yāmesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti. so ce evaṃ vadeyya: “tāvatiṃsehi kho devehi me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, yāmesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti”. so evamassa vacanīyo: “yāmehi kho āvuso, devehi
sn55.54:7.4: tusitā devā abhikkantarā ca paṇītatarā ca. sādhāyasmā yāmehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā tusitesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti. so ce evaṃ vadeyya: “yāmehi devehi me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, tusitesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti”. so evamassa vacanīyo: “tusitehi kho āvuso, devehi
sn55.54:7.5: nimmāṇaratī devā abhikkantarā ca paṇītatarā ca. sādhāyasmā tusitehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā nimmāṇaratīsu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti. so ce evaṃ vadeyya: “tusitehi devehi me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, nimmāṇaratīsu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti”. so evamassa vacanīyo: “nimmāṇaratīhi kho āvuso, devehi
sn55.54:7.6: paranimmitavasavattī devā abhikkantarā ca paṇītatarā ca. sādhāyasmā nimmāṇaratīhi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā paranimmitavasavattīsu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti. so ce evaṃ vadeyya: “nimmāṇaratīhi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, paranimmitavasavattīsu devesu cittaṃ adhimocitanti”. so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:7.7: “paranimmitavasavattīhi kho āvuso, devehi brahmaloko abhikkantaro ca paṇītataro ca.
sn55.54:7.8: sādhāyasmā paranimmitavasavattīhi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā brahmaloke cittaṃ adhimocehī”ti.
sn55.54:7.10: paranimmitavasavattīhi kho devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, brahmaloke cittaṃ adhimocitanti”, so evamassa vacanīyo:
sn55.54:7.12: sādhāyasmā brahmalokā cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ upasaṃharā”ti.
sn55.54:8.2: “brahmalokā me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ upasaṃhatanti”
sn55.54:8.3: evaṃ vimuttacittassa kho mahānāma upāsakassa vassasatavimuttacittena bhikkhunā na kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ
